summary: Implemented the feature without running tests, flake8, or repository code. New engine-free modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py and changed the write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler are now thin adapters over these. Updated callers to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Added tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Checked by reading only: no lines over 120 characters and no leftover output_path references. Nothing is committed. Choices I made: a duplicated private absent-meta helper in each saver module, blank CSV rows skipped on overwrite-false merge, tensor affines converted to numpy, and no new TensorBoard index test.
